scene.label: Act 2, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. A room in Caesar's palace.

content.text: Thunder and lightning. Enter Caesar, in his nightgown.

lines.text: Nor heaven nor earth have been at peace tonight:
lines.plainText: Nor heaven nor earth have been at peace tonight

lines.text: Thrice hath Calphurnia in her sleep cried out,
lines.plainText: Thrice hath Calphurnia in her sleep cried out

lines.text: "Help, ho! They murder Caesar!" Who's within?
lines.plainText: Help ho They murder Caesar Who's within

lines.text: My lord?
lines.plainText: My lord

lines.text: Go bid the priests do present sacrifice,
lines.plainText: Go bid the priests do present sacrifice

lines.text: And bring me their opinions of success.
lines.plainText: And bring me their opinions of success

lines.text: I will, my lord.
lines.plainText: I will my lord

lines.text: What mean you, Caesar? Think you to walk forth?
lines.plainText: What mean you Caesar Think you to walk forth

lines.text: You shall not stir out of your house today.
lines.plainText: You shall not stir out of your house today

lines.text: Caesar shall forth. The things that threaten'd me
lines.plainText: Caesar shall forth The things that threaten'd me

lines.text: Ne'er look'd but on my back; when they shall see
lines.plainText: Ne'er look'd but on my back when they shall see

lines.text: The face of Caesar, they are vanished.
lines.plainText: The face of Caesar they are vanished

lines.text: Caesar, I never stood on ceremonies,
lines.plainText: Caesar I never stood on ceremonies

lines.text: Yet now they fright me. There is one within,
lines.plainText: Yet now they fright me There is one within

lines.text: Besides the things that we have heard and seen,
lines.plainText: Besides the things that we have heard and seen

lines.text: Recounts most horrid sights seen by the watch.
lines.plainText: Recounts most horrid sights seen by the watch

lines.text: A lioness hath whelped in the streets,
lines.plainText: A lioness hath whelped in the streets

lines.text: And graves have yawn'd, and yielded up their dead;
lines.plainText: And graves have yawn'd and yielded up their dead

lines.text: Fierce fiery warriors fight upon the clouds
lines.plainText: Fierce fiery warriors fight upon the clouds

lines.text: In ranks and squadrons and right form of war,
lines.plainText: In ranks and squadrons and right form of war

lines.text: Which drizzled blood upon the Capitol;
lines.plainText: Which drizzled blood upon the Capitol

lines.text: The noise of battle hurtled in the air,
lines.plainText: The noise of battle hurtled in the air

lines.text: Horses did neigh, and dying men did groan,
lines.plainText: Horses did neigh and dying men did groan

lines.text: And ghosts did shriek and squeal about the streets.
lines.plainText: And ghosts did shriek and squeal about the streets

lines.text: O Caesar, these things are beyond all use,
lines.plainText: O Caesar these things are beyond all use

lines.text: And I do fear them!
lines.plainText: And I do fear them

lines.text: What can be avoided
lines.plainText: What can be avoided

lines.text: Whose end is purpos'd by the mighty gods?
lines.plainText: Whose end is purpos'd by the mighty gods

lines.text: Yet Caesar shall go forth; for these predictions
lines.plainText: Yet Caesar shall go forth for these predictions

lines.text: Are to the world in general as to Caesar.
lines.plainText: Are to the world in general as to Caesar

lines.text: When beggars die, there are no comets seen;
lines.plainText: When beggars die there are no comets seen

lines.text: The heavens themselves blaze forth the death of princes.
lines.plainText: The heavens themselves blaze forth the death of princes

lines.text: Cowards die many times before their deaths;
lines.plainText: Cowards die many times before their deaths

lines.text: The valiant never taste of death but once.
lines.plainText: The valiant never taste of death but once

lines.text: Of all the wonders that I yet have heard,
lines.plainText: Of all the wonders that I yet have heard

lines.text: It seems to me most strange that men should fear,
lines.plainText: It seems to me most strange that men should fear

lines.text: Seeing that death, a necessary end,
lines.plainText: Seeing that death a necessary end

lines.text: Will come when it will come.
lines.plainText: Will come when it will come

lines.text: They would not have you to stir forth today.
lines.plainText: They would not have you to stir forth today

lines.text: Plucking the entrails of an offering forth,
lines.plainText: Plucking the entrails of an offering forth

lines.text: They could not find a heart within the beast.
lines.plainText: They could not find a heart within the beast

lines.text: The gods do this in shame of cowardice:
lines.plainText: The gods do this in shame of cowardice

lines.text: Caesar should be a beast without a heart
lines.plainText: Caesar should be a beast without a heart

lines.text: If he should stay at home today for fear.
lines.plainText: If he should stay at home today for fear

lines.text: No, Caesar shall not. Danger knows full well
lines.plainText: No Caesar shall not Danger knows full well

lines.text: That Caesar is more dangerous than he.
lines.plainText: That Caesar is more dangerous than he

lines.text: We are two lions litter'd in one day,
lines.plainText: We are two lions litter'd in one day

lines.text: And I the elder and more terrible,
lines.plainText: And I the elder and more terrible

lines.text: And Caesar shall go forth.
lines.plainText: And Caesar shall go forth

lines.text: Alas, my lord,
lines.plainText: Alas my lord

lines.text: Your wisdom is consum'd in confidence.
lines.plainText: Your wisdom is consum'd in confidence

lines.text: Do not go forth today: call it my fear
lines.plainText: Do not go forth today call it my fear

lines.text: That keeps you in the house, and not your own.
lines.plainText: That keeps you in the house and not your own

lines.text: We'll send Mark Antony to the Senate-house,
lines.plainText: We'll send Mark Antony to the Senatehouse

lines.text: And he shall say you are not well today.
lines.plainText: And he shall say you are not well today

lines.text: Let me upon my knee prevail in this.
lines.plainText: Let me upon my knee prevail in this

lines.text: Mark Antony shall say I am not well,
lines.plainText: Mark Antony shall say I am not well

lines.text: And for thy humour, I will stay at home.
lines.plainText: And for thy humour I will stay at home

lines.text: Caesar, all hail! Good morrow, worthy Caesar.
lines.plainText: Caesar all hail Good morrow worthy Caesar

lines.text: I come to fetch you to the Senate-house.
lines.plainText: I come to fetch you to the Senatehouse

lines.text: And you are come in very happy time
lines.plainText: And you are come in very happy time

lines.text: To bear my greeting to the Senators,
lines.plainText: To bear my greeting to the Senators

lines.text: And tell them that I will not come today.
lines.plainText: And tell them that I will not come today

lines.text: Cannot, is false; and that I dare not, falser:
lines.plainText: Cannot is false and that I dare not falser

lines.text: I will not come today. Tell them so, Decius.
lines.plainText: I will not come today Tell them so Decius

lines.text: Say he is sick.
lines.plainText: Say he is sick

lines.text: Shall Caesar send a lie?
lines.plainText: Shall Caesar send a lie

lines.text: Have I in conquest stretch'd mine arm so far,
lines.plainText: Have I in conquest stretch'd mine arm so far

lines.text: To be afeard to tell grey-beards the truth?
lines.plainText: To be afeard to tell greybeards the truth

lines.text: Decius, go tell them Caesar will not come.
lines.plainText: Decius go tell them Caesar will not come

lines.text: Most mighty Caesar, let me know some cause,
lines.plainText: Most mighty Caesar let me know some cause

lines.text: Lest I be laugh'd at when I tell them so.
lines.plainText: Lest I be laugh'd at when I tell them so

lines.text: The cause is in my will; I will not come.
lines.plainText: The cause is in my will I will not come

lines.text: That is enough to satisfy the Senate.
lines.plainText: That is enough to satisfy the Senate

lines.text: But for your private satisfaction,
lines.plainText: But for your private satisfaction

lines.text: Because I love you, I will let you know:
lines.plainText: Because I love you I will let you know

lines.text: Calphurnia here, my wife, stays me at home.
lines.plainText: Calphurnia here my wife stays me at home

lines.text: She dreamt tonight she saw my statue,
lines.plainText: She dreamt tonight she saw my statue

lines.text: Which like a fountain with an hundred spouts
lines.plainText: Which like a fountain with an hundred spouts

lines.text: Did run pure blood; and many lusty Romans
lines.plainText: Did run pure blood and many lusty Romans

lines.text: Came smiling, and did bathe their hands in it.
lines.plainText: Came smiling and did bathe their hands in it

lines.text: And these does she apply for warnings and portents
lines.plainText: And these does she apply for warnings and portents

lines.text: And evils imminent; and on her knee
lines.plainText: And evils imminent and on her knee

lines.text: Hath begg'd that I will stay at home today.
lines.plainText: Hath begg'd that I will stay at home today

lines.text: This dream is all amiss interpreted:
lines.plainText: This dream is all amiss interpreted

lines.text: It was a vision fair and fortunate.
lines.plainText: It was a vision fair and fortunate

lines.text: Your statue spouting blood in many pipes,
lines.plainText: Your statue spouting blood in many pipes

lines.text: In which so many smiling Romans bath'd,
lines.plainText: In which so many smiling Romans bath'd

lines.text: Signifies that from you great Rome shall suck
lines.plainText: Signifies that from you great Rome shall suck

lines.text: Reviving blood, and that great men shall press
lines.plainText: Reviving blood and that great men shall press

lines.text: For tinctures, stains, relics, and cognizance.
lines.plainText: For tinctures stains relics and cognizance

lines.text: This by Calphurnia's dream is signified.
lines.plainText: This by Calphurnia's dream is signified

lines.text: And this way have you well expounded it.
lines.plainText: And this way have you well expounded it

lines.text: I have, when you have heard what I can say;
lines.plainText: I have when you have heard what I can say

lines.text: And know it now. The Senate have concluded
lines.plainText: And know it now The Senate have concluded

lines.text: To give this day a crown to mighty Caesar.
lines.plainText: To give this day a crown to mighty Caesar

lines.text: If you shall send them word you will not come,
lines.plainText: If you shall send them word you will not come

lines.text: Their minds may change. Besides, it were a mock
lines.plainText: Their minds may change Besides it were a mock

lines.text: Apt to be render'd, for someone to say,
lines.plainText: Apt to be render'd for someone to say

lines.text: "Break up the Senate till another time,
lines.plainText: Break up the Senate till another time

lines.text: When Caesar's wife shall meet with better dreams."
lines.plainText: When Caesar's wife shall meet with better dreams

lines.text: If Caesar hide himself, shall they not whisper
lines.plainText: If Caesar hide himself shall they not whisper

lines.text: "Lo, Caesar is afraid"?
lines.plainText: Lo Caesar is afraid

lines.text: Pardon me, Caesar; for my dear dear love
lines.plainText: Pardon me Caesar for my dear dear love

lines.text: To your proceeding bids me tell you this,
lines.plainText: To your proceeding bids me tell you this

lines.text: And reason to my love is liable.
lines.plainText: And reason to my love is liable

lines.text: How foolish do your fears seem now, Calphurnia!
lines.plainText: How foolish do your fears seem now Calphurnia

lines.text: I am ashamed I did yield to them.
lines.plainText: I am ashamed I did yield to them

lines.text: Give me my robe, for I will go.
lines.plainText: Give me my robe for I will go

content.text: Enter Brutus, Ligarius, Metellus, Casca, Trebonius, Cinna and Publius.

lines.text: Good morrow, Caesar.
lines.plainText: Good morrow Caesar

lines.text: Welcome, Publius.
lines.plainText: Welcome Publius

lines.text: What, Brutus, are you stirr'd so early too?
lines.plainText: What Brutus are you stirr'd so early too

lines.text: Good morrow, Casca. Caius Ligarius,
lines.plainText: Good morrow Casca Caius Ligarius

lines.text: Caesar was ne'er so much your enemy
lines.plainText: Caesar was ne'er so much your enemy

lines.text: As that same ague which hath made you lean.
lines.plainText: As that same ague which hath made you lean

lines.text: What is't o'clock?
lines.plainText: What is't o'clock

lines.text: Caesar, 'tis strucken eight.
lines.plainText: Caesar 'tis strucken eight

lines.text: I thank you for your pains and courtesy.
lines.plainText: I thank you for your pains and courtesy

lines.text: So to most noble Caesar.
lines.plainText: So to most noble Caesar

lines.text: Bid them prepare within.
lines.plainText: Bid them prepare within

lines.text: I am to blame to be thus waited for.
lines.plainText: I am to blame to be thus waited for

lines.text: Now, Cinna; now, Metellus; what, Trebonius!
lines.plainText: Now Cinna now Metellus what Trebonius

lines.text: I have an hour's talk in store for you:
lines.plainText: I have an hour's talk in store for you

lines.text: Remember that you call on me today;
lines.plainText: Remember that you call on me today

lines.text: Be near me, that I may remember you.
lines.plainText: Be near me that I may remember you

lines.text: Caesar, I will. [Aside.] and so near will I be,
lines.plainText: Caesar I will Aside and so near will I be

lines.text: That your best friends shall wish I had been further.
lines.plainText: That your best friends shall wish I had been further

lines.text: Good friends, go in, and taste some wine with me;
lines.plainText: Good friends go in and taste some wine with me

lines.text: And we, like friends, will straightway go together.
lines.plainText: And we like friends will straightway go together

lines.text: [Aside.] That every like is not the same, O Caesar,
lines.plainText: Aside That every like is not the same O Caesar

lines.text: The heart of Brutus yearns to think upon.
lines.plainText: The heart of Brutus yearns to think upon
